Name: Araunah the Jebusite
Summary: Araunah the Jebusite owned the threshingfloor where the destroying angel stopped during the plague after David's census. David insisted on buying it at full price rather than accepting it as a gift, and built an altar there — the future site of the temple.
KeyStory: Araunah offered his threshingfloor free, but David bought it at full price for an altar.
LifeLesson: A sacrifice that costs nothing is no sacrifice — David would not offer one.
